firstPlayerRule: There is no first player: everyone plays each round at the same time. Only when strict timing matters, a phase is done in clockwise order starting with the player whose faction tile has the lowest number.
clarifications: All players roll, select phases and carry out phases simultaneously; there are no separate player turns.
Strict clockwise order is only needed in rare cases, such as when someone might reach 12 tile squares or the VP chip pool might run out.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rulebook from riograndegames.com (https://www.riograndegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/Roll-for-the-Galaxy-Rules.pdf), SHA-256 b0860e211ab7fd01a414e5d587d614e7e50f5e4d4ac6027eb1394a926a408689, and extracted the text of all 12 pages. Page 3 says each step is done simultaneously by all players. Page 9, Timing: most play is simultaneous; when strict timing is needed, do the phase in clockwise player order, starting with the player with the lowest numbered faction tile. Page 12, Frequently Overlooked Rules: play is simultaneous with no separate player turns; credits show copyright 2014 Wei-Hwa Huang, Tom Lehmann and 2014, 2020 Rio Grande Games. The dice-and-tiles space empire game by Huang and Lehmann matches BGG 132531. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The lowest-faction-number order applies only when timing matters; the rulebook has no general starting player.
The hosting path contains 2013; the edition date used is the 2014 copyright line (the file also lists 2020 for Rio Grande Games).
